Getting started¶

Requirements¶

  • Python 3.10 or newer

  • pip

Install and run locally¶

Create a virtual environment from the project root and install the packages:

python -m venv .venv
.venv/Scripts/activate
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python manage.py migrate
python manage.py runserver

Open http://127.0.0.1:8000/ for the site and http://127.0.0.1:8000/admin/ for the administration interface. SQLite is the default database, and Django’s console email backend keeps development messages in the server terminal.

Configuration¶

The application reads optional settings from environment variables. Copy .env.example to .env only when you need to customize them. The example values are placeholders; use private values for DJANGO_SECRET_KEY and APPROVED_API_SECRET in real deployments. Do not commit .env.

Set DB_ENGINE=mysql and provide the DB_* variables to use MariaDB. The container workflow uses a persistent SQLite volume by default.

Build the Sphinx site`n———————

With the project environment active, run:

sphinx-build -b html docs docs/_build/html

Open docs/_build/html/index.html in a browser to browse the generated site.
